description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a single filter narrows the list to matching products
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open as a customer; <a filter with a value matched by some but not all products in the list> is available.
steps: Note the products currently shown in the unfiltered list.
Apply <the filter value matched by some but not all products>.
Compare the resulting list with the list noted in step 1.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed to only the products matching the applied filter value; products that do not match it are no longer shown.

cases.title: Applying two filters narrows the list further
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open as a customer; <two filters whose values, applied together, match fewer products than either one alone> are available.
steps: Apply <the first filter value> and note the products shown.
Compare the resulting list with the list noted in step 1.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed again and shows only the products matching both filter values; products matching only one of them are no longer shown.

cases.title: Filter value that no product matches
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open as a customer; <a filter value that no product in the list matches> is available.
steps: Apply <the filter value that no product matches>.
cases.expected: No products are listed, since no product matches the filter. The exact wording or appearance of any empty-result message is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Filter value matched by every product in the list
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open as a customer; <a filter value that every product in the list matches> is available.
steps: Note the products currently shown in the unfiltered list.
Apply <the filter value that every product matches>.
Compare the resulting list with the list noted in step 1.
cases.expected: All products that match the filter are still listed - the same products as before - because every one of them matches; none are removed.
